description: Reviewed GitHub repository transfers. A redirect from `from` to `to` is a confirmed move, not a typo-squat, so the listing can stay Verified. Owner and repo names are compared case-insensitively. The verifier never rewrites stored repo links from these redirects.

transfers.note: OpenBB wound down; OpenBQ foundation (BrightQuery-funded) stewards the code, per founder's post.
